texts.LwcBuilder_Error_Generic: LWC Builder could not do that. The details are in the Error Log.
texts.LwcBuilder_Error_Key: The key must start with a letter and hold only letters, digits and underscores, up to 80 characters.
texts.LwcBuilder_Error_KeyUsed: Another component already uses the key {0}. Keys are unique, whatever the capitals.
texts.LwcBuilder_Error_Object: There is no object called {0} in this org. Use its API name, such as Contact or Gift__c.
texts.LwcBuilder_Error_TooLarge: This component is too large to save. Split it into two components.
texts.LwcBuilder_Error_Definition: This is not a component the LWC Builder can read. Open it in the builder and save it again.
texts.LwcBuilder_Error_Field: {0} is not a field on {1}. Check the API name in Object Manager.
texts.LwcBuilder_Error_FilterValue: {0} is not a value {1} can hold. Use a number, a date written 2026-12-31, or true or false.
texts.LwcBuilder_Chart_NoReport: There is no report with the API name {0} that you can open. Use the report's Report Unique Name.
texts.LwcBuilder_Chart_NotChartable: {0} cannot be charted. Use a summary or matrix report with at least one grouping and one summary.
texts.LwcBuilder_Block_NeedsRecord: This block shows a record's fields, so it appears on record pages. In the preview, enter a record Id.
texts.LwcBuilder_Preview_Empty: Nothing to show yet. Add a section and drag blocks into it.
texts.LwcBuilder_Studio_Intro: Build a component from blocks on a 12-column grid, preview it with a record, save it, then place BarnCRM Built Component on any Lightning page and pick it. Every block shows only what the viewer may see.
texts.LwcBuilder_Studio_BlocksHelp: Drag a block onto a column, or select a column and press a block to add it there.
texts.LwcBuilder_Studio_EmptyCanvas: Start with Add Section, or press a block to start a section with it.
texts.LwcBuilder_Studio_NoSelection: Select a block to change it.
texts.LwcBuilder_Field_KeyHelp: The unique name a Lightning page stores to find this component. Letters, digits and underscores. Keep it when you move the component to another org.
texts.LwcBuilder_Field_ObjectHelp: The API name of the object whose record pages this is for, such as Contact. Leave it blank for app and home pages.
texts.LwcBuilder_Prop_FieldsHelp: Field API names separated by commas, up to six, such as Name, Email, Phone.
texts.LwcBuilder_Prop_UrlHelp: A Salesforce address such as /resource/YourLogo, or an https address listed in Setup, Trusted URLs.
texts.LwcBuilder_Prop_PassRecordId: Pass the record Id (as the flow's recordId input)
texts.LwcBuilder_Rule_Help: Decides only what is shown. It is not a security control: use permission sets and sharing for that.
texts.LwcBuilder_Rule_FieldValue: When a field on the page record has a value
texts.LwcBuilder_Rule_PermissionType: When the user holds a custom permission
texts.LwcBuilder_Rule_Lacks: Show when the user does not hold it
texts.LwcBuilder_Problem_RowWidth: A row's columns must add up to 12. Pick a layout for it.
texts.LwcBuilder_Problem_ParentField: enter the lookup field that points at the page record.
texts.LwcBuilder_Problem_ImageUrl: use a Salesforce address starting with / or an https address.
texts.LwcBuilder_Problem_ImageAlt: describe the image in Alternative text.
texts.LwcBuilder_Problem_Action: enter the quick action or flow API name.
texts.LwcBuilder_Problem_RuleField: the visibility rule needs a field API name and a condition.
texts.LwcBuilder_Problem_RulePermission: the visibility rule needs a custom permission API name.
texts.LwcBuilder_Problem_Other: this block cannot be shown. Remove it.
texts.LwcBuilder_Export_Intro: The component as an LWC bundle for a developer to finish, deploy and maintain. List and chart blocks are placeholders with a comment saying what to connect. Nothing is deployed for you.
